Run: cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain."; "A test changes a reading-relevant config value (e.g. a budget cap or capability definition), so drain rereads; when the new reading has the same capability and deliverables as the old, drain accepts it and runs the job to a landed outcome in the same drain. Run: cargo test."; "A test where the reread scope differs (different capability or deliverables) does not run silently: the drain leaves the item with a clear reason that the reading needs accepting, and does not stop with 'repeated failure'. Run: cargo test."; "Drain never calls retry on a job that is still proposed: when a run ends with no outcome, the drain's next attempt is a run/accept of that job, not 'only a rejected or failed job can be tried again'. A regression test reproduces the 01:48 sequence (max_concurrency 1 to 2) and asserts the stop reason is not 'repeated failure'. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli."; redacted report: {"summary":"Fixed both faults behind the 01:48 drain that landed nothing. (1) Reading validity compared the raw bytes of athena.toml, so changing `[parallel] max_concurrency` invalidated every reading. It now compares a hash of `Config::reading_inputs()`, the parsed settings minus `[parallel]` and `[landing]`; defaults.toml is still compared by bytes. (2) When a relevant change forces a reread, `go` with `AcceptedBy::Flag` (drain, `--yes`) accepts the new reading and runs the job if `reading::same_scope` holds (same capability, class of work, deliverable paths and actions). A reread with a different scope is returned as `GoResult::Reread`, as is any reread for `AcceptedBy::User`, so interactive `go` is unchanged. (3) Drain no longer calls retry on a job that is still proposed: only a Rejected or Failed outcome leads to `athena retry`. Any other no-outcome run is run again as the same reading. A reread whose scope changed is reported as outcome \"needs accepting\" with the reason, plus a note. It is not a failure, so it does not end in \"repeated failure\", and drain carries on to the next item. A new `Run.needs_accepting` field carries this. Doc comments (GoResult::Reread, the D38 rule, the drain module text) and CHANGELOG are updated.
